name: Necromancer: Undead: Assault spares neutral monster-masked mobs while pulling hostile ones (#10255)
contract: Issue #10255. Undead: Assault (500982) puts Necromancer minions into aggressive stance. Blackfathom Deeps neutral turtles such as Snapping Crustacean (4822) use FactionTemplate 350 (ourMask 8 = FACTION_MASK_MONSTER, hostileMask 0), so player->IsHostileTo(turtle) and minion->IsHostileTo(turtle) are true while turtle->IsHostileTo(player) is false (REP_NEUTRAL).

Before the fix, both CreatureAI::MoveInLineOfSight (under REACT_AGGRESSIVE) and UpdateAI's 20-yard scan checked only one-sided hostility toward the target and immediately pulled faction-350 neutral mobs.

Discriminating check: with Undead: Assault active and a Lesser Skeletal Warrior (50065) raised 5 yards from a faction-350 Snapping Crustacean, the minion must not target it and neither the turtle nor the Necromancer may enter combat.
Control: after teleporting beside a faction-128 hostile creature (ourMask 8, hostileMask 1) 35 yards away without attacking, the same Assault minion must autonomously engage that hostile creature.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: Undead: Assault aura is active
SETUP: Lesser Skeletal Warrior is present
Let MoveInLineOfSight and several 1-second Assault scans run beside the neutral turtle
DISCRIMINATING: Assault minion does not target the faction-350 neutral turtle
DISCRIMINATING: the neutral turtle never enters combat
DISCRIMINATING: the Necromancer stays out of combat
Move beside the hostile creature 35 yards away
CONTROL: Assault minion autonomously engages the faction-128 hostile creature
CONTROL: the hostile creature enters combat
